description: Corteva, Inc. is a leading global provider of seed and crop protection solutions focused on the agriculture industry and contributing to a healthier, more secure and sustainable food supply. Incorporated in Delaware in March 2018 with business headquarters in Indianapolis, Indiana, it has one of the broadest and most productive new product pipelines in the agriculture industry and is focused on progressing science-based innovations that aim to deliver a wide range of improved agriculture products and services to its customers, leveraging its rich heritage of scientific achievement to advance its robust innovation pipeline and shape the future of responsible agriculture. Its Seed segment offers seed and trait technologies that boost resilience to weather, pests, diseases and herbicides used to manage weeds, plus digital solutions that provide data-driven insights to help farmers optimize yield and profitability, with major brands including Pioneer, Brevant Seeds, Dairyland Seed, Hoegemeyer Hybrids, Nutech Seed, Seed Consultants, AgVenture, Pannar and PhytoGen cottonseed, and traits and technologies including ENLIST corn, ENLIST E3 soybeans and ENLIST cotton.
